pending_set_projection_rule: Compare the pending arrays only for pair.pending and pair.pending-after-refusals as sets using exact projected object equality; every other projected value and its ordering remain unchanged.
assertions: Both captures successfully ran all nine fixture assertions, including byte-identical pending disclosure within each capture and after graceful handler restart, no provider or fetch calls, and local tool invocation counts.
limitation: This is limited projection repeatability. Raw generated tokens, interrupts, checkpoint fields, message internals and two independent pending prompt orders differ. It establishes no whole-response equality or TypeScript-to-Rust parity.
